stories.title: Nasdaq hits record high as chipmakers lead gains
stories.summary: The Nasdaq Composite closed at a record high, with chipmaker stocks driving the gains, Investing.com reported. The move extends a rally tied to strength in semiconductor and technology shares.
stories.whyItMatters: Chip stocks have been a lead driver of the broader market's AI-linked rally, so a record close signals continued investor confidence in the sector.
whatToWatch: Whether chipmaker gains hold or broaden in coming sessions
Upcoming earnings from major semiconductor companies
questions: Which chipmakers led the move, and why?
Can the rally extend, or is this a short-term spike?
